opening: I've been having pain in my right foot.
It's in the sole of my right foot.
It gets worse when I raise my foot above chest level during exercises.
The pain goes away completely after a few minutes of rest.
I get cramps in my right calf when I use the incline on the treadmill.
I've had type 2 diabetes for 8 years.
I smoke two packs of cigarettes a day and have done so for 34 years.
I started exercising regularly 2 months ago.

opening.text: I've been having pain in my right foot, specifically in the sole. It's a tingling pain that started 6 weeks ago. It gets worse when I raise my foot above chest level during exercises, but it goes away completely after a few minutes of rest. I also get cramps in my right calf when I use the incline on the treadmill. I started exercising regularly 2 months ago. I've had type 2 diabetes for 8 years, and I smoke two packs of cigarettes a day and have done so for 34 years.
